submission.natural_language_explanation: L4/N1814+ reacts to the onset of a low-frequency or unfamiliar word: it peaks on the first token of technical/scientific terms, code identifiers, proper names, foreign words and nonce words, most reliably when the tokenizer splits the word into several pieces (innervation -> ' inn'+'ervation', fracking -> ' fr'+'acking', flimbex -> ' fl'+'imb'+'ex'). It also peaks on possessive determiners in prepositional frames ('harmful to your ...'), and its output direction boosts word-internal continuation pieces such as 'ervation', 'ology' and 'acking', while it stays quiet on common whole words and on the continuation pieces themselves.

rival_explanations: A generic token-rarity detector rather than a word-onset unit: any low-frequency or unknown token should fire it wherever it sits, so whole rare words (' mitochondrial', ' chromatography', ' whatsoever') and rare continuation pieces would be as active as word onsets.

A possessive/affected-entity unit: the real trigger is a possessive determiner marking an affected person ('harmful to your ...'), so possessives should fire in any such frame while pure technical vocabulary and nonce word onsets should stay quiet.

top_examples.text: 'Where history meets hospitality' is more than the motto of this truly remarkable centrally located hotel, it is a statement of intent. The hotel stands on a site that has a heritage dating back to Roman Britain, and many unearthed artefacts are proudly displayed in the Museum of London. The Thames Path is near to the hotel and a relaxing walk along the River Thames is particularly recommended in the summer months, whilst a spin on the London Eye will provide spectacular views of a truly great city at any time of year. The hotel prides itself on high quality service and all rooms have private bathroom, satellite TV, radio, high speed internet access, mini-bar, hairdryer, trouser press, iron and board, safe and tea/coffee making facilities. 德约：汲取小威全满贯失利教训，将把决赛当作生涯最后一战
北京时间昨天上午11点10分，德约科维奇在美网男单上半区的半决赛中以4-6/6-2/6-4/4-6/6-2击败了兹维列夫，决赛将迎战2号种子梅德韦德夫。
“除了德约科维奇，我相信没有人能够复制罗德拉沃尔1969年连夺四大满贯的奇迹，”落败后的兹维列夫说。“我相信他会做到的，他打破了每一项记录。”
“如果去翻翻统计数据，如果只谈论网球比赛，德约科维奇无疑是有史以来最伟大的球员，没有人与之比肩。他是世界第一周数最多的人，也最有可能是大师赛冠军最多的人，并且最终还会成为夺得大满贯最多的人。更要命的是，他还有机会赢得年度全满贯。想想吧，你拿什么与他竞争？”
相比一年前，兹维列夫的进步和改变是显而易见的，他的发球在保证球速和落点的同时大大提升了稳定性，不再出现频繁而离谱的双误。底线击球更扎实，且攻防兼备。最重要的是，他的情绪管控能力有了显著提升，不再如过去那样容易崩溃，也很少看到他遇到挫折时一泻千里。
在这场半决赛上，兹维列夫已打得足够好，已倾尽所有，最终仍被德约科维奇击败。他用一场百折千回的失败再次警醒梅德韦德夫，要想在大满贯五盘三胜的比赛中击败德约科维奇是多么困难，要付出多么大的努力。
令人印象深刻的时刻发生在第3盘第10局，兹维列夫与德约科维奇打了53拍的长多拍相持，这不仅是美网历史上拍数最多的1分，也是德约科维奇今年大满贯比赛中耗时最长的1分。即便兹维列夫赢下了这个艰难、精彩的1分，他也无法说服自己一定能赢得整场比赛。
先丢一盘，然后连拿两盘，接着再丢一盘，这是德约科维奇比赛前四盘的情况。在决胜盘开始前，双方都回到了相同的起点，两人此刻的心里都在想什么呢？没有人知道答案。

Cyber risk has evolved as a major threat to the financial industry in recent years. While the internal risks associated with process and system failures have traditionally been dominant, external threats in the form of ransomware attacks, data breaches, and business disruptions are more significant and widespread today than ever before.
With the growing popularity of internet banking and card payment systems, cybersecurity is a profound concern for banks on the road to digitalization. Vulnerabilities in banks’ cyber infrastructure have been repeatedly exposed, particularly over the past decade or so. From prominent central banks to small commercial banks around the world, victims of cybercrime have lost millions of dollars and crucial data to hackers.
Banks have been a top target of cyber criminals owing to their huge stores of cash and possession of sensitive consumer data. A recent survey by a US-based IT security firm has found that websites of banking and financial institutions are more vulnerable to getting hacked than those of any other industry. While the majority of such attacks are successfully fended off by banks’ cybersecurity apparatus, successful intrusions into the bank’s systems can put critical data at stake. This can have serious repercussions, not just in terms of financial losses and regulatory sanctions, but also reputational losses, as banks rely heavily on the trust of their customers.
Over the past decade, data breaches and fraud have been the most common forms of cyber attacks on banks, although, business disruption is also prevalent. In 2014, it emerged that 20 million bank accounts had been hacked in South Korea over the course of several years. An American credit company, Equifax, revealed in 2017 that it had suffered a cyber attack over the course of several months, which had resulted in the breach of 200,000 credit cards’ data, in addition to the personal information of 143 million customers across three countries.
In 2014, phishing emails were circulated indicating that FIB, Bulgaria’s largest domestic bank, was experiencing a liquidity shortage. This unusual form of cyber attack caused a bank run at FIB, and 10 percent of the bank’s total deposits were withdrawn in a single day. In 2012, the websites of Bank of America, PNC, JPMorgan, US Bancorp, and Wells Fargo were simultaneously targeted, while seven major financial institutions of Norway suffered a cyber attack on a single day during 2014. According to Financial Times, cyber attacks on fintech firms have led to losses worth USD 1,450 million due to fraud since 2013.
